item.title: NASA’s Webb Telescope Discovers Carbon Dioxide in the Atmosphere of a Distant Exoplanet
item.description: NASA’s James Webb Space Telescope has captured the first clear evidence of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere of a gas giant planet orbiting a Sun-like star 700 light-years away. The detection gives researchers a new way to study how distant planets form. The post NASA’s Webb Telescope Discovers Carbon Dioxide in the Atmosphere of a Distant Exoplanet appeared first on NASA Science .
